entries.summary: Usual Light fare: one cabin bag up to 8 kg; checked baggage is not included.
entries.notes: Fare-family and route rules can change; verify on AEGEAN before booking.

entries.summary: Usual Basic fare: one small personal bag under the seat; larger cabin and checked bags cost extra.
entries.cabin: 1 small personal bag, 40 x 30 x 20 cm

entries.summary: Usual Economy Lite fare: hand baggage only; Value/Flex fares include checked baggage.

entries.summary: Usual Light package: limited under-seat/cabin allowance; cabin or checked baggage may need to be purchased.

entries.summary: Usual Economy Discount fare: one hand baggage item and one personal item; checked baggage depends on fare/route.

entries.summary: Usual Basic fare: one free small cabin bag; trolley cabin bag and checked baggage cost extra unless bundled.
